objective: Let a local product owner approve one immutable unsent Release Communication for a Completed Fix while preserving exact source lineage and keeping publication outside SignalDesk and Elder authority.
scope: Add the Release Communications bounded context and completion-to-communication workflow.
Create at most one immutable Release Communication for an existing Completed Fix in a locked PostgreSQL transaction.
Persist the intended audience, subject, message, unverified local approver label, and server approval time.
Add POST /api/v1/completed-fixes/{completedFixId}/release-communication and an additive releaseCommunication Signal-detail projection.
Expose the complete Feedback-to-Release Communication trace through the local product interface while displaying publicationStatus as not-sent.
Add a product-owned lifecycle contract connected to the Completed Fix lifecycle stage.
Attempt the reviewable-PR target through Elder and correct only one reproduced generalized blocker.
non_goals: Sending, publishing, scheduling, customer contact integration, provider credentials, deployment, release execution, or delivery tracking.
Editing, deletion, multiple communications per fix, authentication, verified identity, tenancy, or public hosting.
L2 or L3 promotion, constitutional changes, another product slice, or changes to institutional qualification thresholds.
evidence_plan: Foundation: validate ADR, contract, work item, connected lifecycle context, Prisma schema, migration, source layout, boundaries, types, lint, and route surface.
Component: prove explicit approval, text bounds, deterministic content checks, server identity/time binding, and not-sent response semantics.
Integration: prove source locking, one immutable communication per fix, exact lineage, concurrency rejection, and PostgreSQL constraints.
Workflow: create the complete feedback-to-approved-communication trace through the local UI and observe persistence after reload at desktop and mobile widths.
Stress: prove concurrent approval has one winner, malformed and missing sources fail closed, database outage recovers with lineage intact, and communication content is absent from logs.
Factory: validate lifecycle-chain continuity, attempt the real reviewable-PR path, record human intervention and active L2 blockers, and preserve authority separation.
